name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability (HuR, TTP, AUF1, BRF1, KSRP) with stress granule assembly/disassembly and stress responses (PKR, arsenite, PML bodies), the stress granule part being what the mRNA-decay confusables lack.

core: Iron uptake and metal stress response
qualifier: transferrin/DMT1 iron import and cadmium detoxification
name: Transferrin iron uptake and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members cover transferrin/SLC11A2 iron import and iron homeostasis plus cadmium transport and detoxification and related oxidative responses, distinguishing them from zinc/copper and heme-centred confusables.

name: Non-canonical NF-kB with CD40, Dectin-1 and IKK immunodeficiencies
rationale: All members concern NIK-driven non-canonical and antigen-receptor NF-kB activation, and unlike confusables (canonical TLR/TNFR1 NF-kB or T cell co-stimulation) the theme includes CD40, Dectin-1, TPL2 and IKBKG/IKBKB/IkBA deficiency diseases.

qualifier: factor V, VIII and IX defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation cascade with factor V, VIII, IX defects
rationale: Members are the coagulation cascade (initiation, intrinsic and common pathways) and many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, which the fibrin, fibrinolysis, VWF and FXII confusables lack.

name: ACTH-driven cortisol secretion and glucocorticoid response
rationale: Members cover ACTH/corticotropin secretion, cortisol/glucocorticoid secretion and cellular glucocorticoid responses, distinct from aldosterone synthesis, corticosterone stress behaviour and GH/leptin confusables.

name: Positive regulation of heart rate, contractile force and relaxation
rationale: All members raise heart rate or force of contraction or regulate cardiac relaxation, whereas confusables concern negative regulation, calcium release or adrenergic secretion.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and basement membrane integrin-laminin
name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members cover desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate-filament-linked cell-cell adhesion, and integrin/laminin/collagen basement membrane anchoring, unlike confusables centred on cornification or adherens/apical junctions.

name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are CS/DS and heparan sulfate proteoglycan catabolism and MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX, distinguishing them from Morquio (keratan sulfate) and Sanfilippo (heparan sulfate only) confusables.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases at centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinases in mitotic centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern early-mitosis regulation of Aurora A (PHLDA1, FBXL7), NEK9/6/7 activation and centrosome separation, unlike confusables on spindle assembly, APC/C or chromosome condensation.

name: Dendrite arborization and filopodium/spine formation
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, filopodium assembly and spine morphogenesis via actin (RHOF), whereas confusables centre on postsynaptic density and synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members include SLC12 cotransporters and their diseases (Bartter, Gitelman), potassium channels and anion homeostasis together with tight-junction paracellular and magnesium transport, combining what each confusable lacks.

qualifier: PIEZO1 shear sensing and calcium-activated scrambling
name: PIEZO1 shear-stress signaling and membrane scrambling/repair
rationale: Members are mechanical stimulus responses (PIEZO1 shear and load, hydrostatic pressure, cell volume) plus membrane blebbing, repair and ANO6 calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, which the eNOS, barrier and flippase confusables lack.

qualifier: non-canonical NF-kB in T cell co-stimulation and IL-2
name: Non-canonical NF-kB in T cell co-stimulation and IL-2
rationale: Members combine NIK/TNFR-family non-canonical NF-kB and antigen-receptor NF-kB with T cell activation, CD27 signaling and IL-2 production, which distinguishes them from the CD40/Dectin-1 sibling and ITK/PKC T cell confusables.

name: Transcriptional cadherin switching in epithelial-mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members regulate CDH1 and CDH11 transcription, TGF-beta-driven EMT and cadherin adhesion, whereas confusables concern cadherin protein trafficking, degradation or adherens junctions.

name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left-right asymmetry, including nodal cilium movement and liver, pancreas and gut laterality, unlike gastrulation, mesoderm or motile cilium assembly confusables.

name: Skeletal myogenesis from myoblast commitment to fiber differentiation
rationale: Members cover myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, fusion and skeletal fiber differentiation, unlike confusables on cardiac muscle, negative regulation or contraction.

core: Response to environmental chemicals and antioxidant vitamins
qualifier: aryl hydrocarbon receptor and vitamin C
name: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor xenobiotic response and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members combine AhR/dioxin, pesticide, bisphenol and genistein responses with ascorbate and vitamin E handling, each block being what one group of confusables lacks.

qualifier: amyloid-beta generation with glial and synaptic effects
name: Amyloid-beta generation and its glial and synaptic effects
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain proteolysis, reduced clearance, responses to amyloid-beta, glial activation/proliferation and LTP suppression, unlike confusables centred on microglial phagocytosis or fibril clearance.

name: Intra-S DNA damage checkpoint and genome stability
rationale: Members are intra-S checkpoint signaling, checkpoint response, recombination intermediate resolution, DNA stability and p53 repair-gene transcription, unlike replication, telomere or crosslink-repair confusables.

name: Na+/Ca2+ exchange and SERCA-mediated ER/SR calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members lower cytosolic calcium via sodium/calcium exchangers and regulate ATPase-driven ER/SR calcium import, whereas confusables centre on ryanodine-receptor calcium release and cardiac contraction.

name: Histone and polyadenylated mRNA 3'-end processing and decapping
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, Pol II termination and SLBP histone mRNA processing plus decapping and 5'-3' decay, which confusables lack (splicing/export, deadenylation or ribosome-associated decay).

qualifier: neutrophil antimicrobial granules and oligopeptide/histidine transport
name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and host-pathogen nutrient transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule and phagocytic programmes with iron/heme assimilation, ion flux at the host-pathogen interface and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, unlike phagosome acidification, histamine or systemic iron confusables.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Class I cytokine receptor signaling via GH, prolactin, leptin, gp130
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT class I receptor pathways for GH, prolactin, leptin, IL-6-family (IL-11, CNTF) and thrombopoietin with body growth control, distinguishing them from thyroid hormone and erythropoietin confusables.

qualifier: IL-5 production and mast cell activation
name: Th2 differentiation, IL-5 production and mast cell activation
rationale: Members promote Th2 differentiation and cytokine (IL-5) production and mast cell activation, unlike confusables centred on eosinophils, IL-4/IL-13 signaling or negative regulation.

core: Neutral and imino amino acid transport
name: Neutral and imino acid transport in Hartnup and iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members cover proline, glycine and tryptophan transporters (SLC6A19, SLC6A20, SLC36A2) and their diseases, unlike oligopeptide, cystine or cationic amino acid transport confusables.
